items.text: I am sorry to learn of Rep. Jennifer Wexton’s diagnosis. I am praying for her and those providing treatment.

Despite its promises, Obamacare has been a disaster for Americans & their insurance.

We must give Americans better access to affordable health care plans that meet their needs. https://t.co/z2S0a7lSMA

https://t.co/1kC5RjCAFP

Our $32 trillion in debt is a threat to the long-term stability of our economy, so reforms to spending shouldn’t be a partisan issue.

#ShrinkWashingtonGrowAmerica

Americans are fed up with the high costs under this Administration. We are working at making that right.

Americans are tired of all the talking but not doing from Congress. I am excited to see my Self-Insurance Protection Act in @EdWorkforceCmte today which will take the fight to Obamacare and lower American's high insurance costs. 🧵Here's how: (1/4)

Employers who manage a self-insured health plan assume the risk of providing health benefits to their workers. These employers pay directly for workers’ health care claims and services. 103 million people received health insurance through a self-insured plan in 2022. (2/4)

Self-insurance is a threat to the Left’s agenda because it gives employers and employees CHOICES. As a result, there has been a push at the federal level to force more people onto Obamacare by attempting to eliminate stop-loss insurance and make costs too high. (3/4)
Americans want action to lower their health care costs, especially with ongoing Bidenflation. It's time to pass my Self-Insurance Protection Act. (4/4) 📺 Watch committee here: https://t.co/odJVOcyE48
